text:
marta (sales): Quick heads-up — BlueArc POC starts tomorrow AM. Primary ask: replace CompetitorX endpoints with our API while preserving prompt/response behavior for core search + summarize flows. Need alignment on scope: adapter shim, tokenization parity, pricing mapping, and security questionnaire answers. @cal can you own technical checklist?

cal (solutions): Yup. I'll take point. Quick checklist draft: 1) request/response mapping (headers, params) 2) tokenization diff & how it affects billing 3) prompt normalization (stop tokens/defaults) 4) rate-limit & retry semantics 5) example harness for A/B evals 6) canary rollout plan (5% -> 25% -> 100%) 7) KMS/VPC/legal items for questionnaire.

jun (eng): For the adapter: plan is lightweight proxy that rewrites CompetitorX body to Redwood schema + tokenization normalization step before send. Prototype curl mapping:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.competitorx.com/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer COMP_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"prompt":"<PROMPT>","max_tokens":512}' 
| # adapter rewrites to: 
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"input":"<PROMPT>","max_total_tokens":512, "stop":["\n\n"]}'
``` We'll add a small token-mapping shim (python) to align token counts.

vikram (security): Send me the BlueArc security questionnaire PDF and the specific sections they highlighted (data residency, KMS, logging). We need to confirm: 1) can we give audit logs per-customer? 2) can we offer customer-managed KMS (yes/no)? 3) network allowlist IPs for staging POC. Also any on-prem requirement?

marta (sales): I'll upload the questionnaire to the thread in a sec and mark the highlighted items. BlueArc specifically called out: EU data residency, SOC2 controls, and HSM-backed keys. They want a demo of VPC peering for the POC.

sam (sales-eng): Pricing note — BlueArc asked for parity vs CompetitorX's flat per-request bundles. Options to propose: A) 1:1 token-based conversion (but adjust for tokenization delta) B) hybrid (flat monthly + usage overage) C) committed throughput (if Dedicated). We should calculate example invoices for a 50k monthly prompt volume with a measured tokenization delta (CompetitorX -> Redwood: +10%).

cal (solutions): For token delta, let's run a sample set of 200 production prompts through both tokenizers. I'll share results by EOD. If it's consistently +10%, we can offer a billing credit for first month or adjust rate to match effective cost.

marie (cs): Canary ops: propose start with synthetic traffic for parity tests (same prompts, same seeds), then route 5% live traffic to Redwood with automatic failback to CompetitorX on >=2 errors/5m. We should also capture exact response diffs (length, stop tokens, parsing failures) so product team can triage.
\ jun (eng): On response deltas — common sources: sampling temperature defaults, stop-seq handling, and whitespace/tokenization differences. Mitigations: 1) explicit temperature/seed in adapter 2) normalize whitespace and punctuation in post-process 3) provide a small prompt-layer that adds engine-specific guardrails (e.g., explicit stop tokens).

cal (solutions): We'll include a tiny eval harness (node script) that side-by-sides outputs and computes a "parity score" (BLEU-ish + token-length delta + structured field match). Example snippet:```js
// pseudo: run side-by-side and compute simple metrics
const left = runCompetitor(prompt);
const right = runRedwood(prompt);
console.log({ tokensLeft: left.tokens, tokensRight: right.tokens, exactMatch: left.text===right.text });
```

vikram (security): KMS answer: we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS in Private/Dedicated; HSM (via partner) is possible for enterprise — need legal + procurement for add-on. For audit logs: yes, we can provide per-customer export (S3 delivery) with retention options. Need to confirm IPs for staging.

marta (sales): BlueArc needs IPs for staging by 9AM tomorrow. Jun — can infra give ephemeral staging IP range for the adapter?

jun (eng): I'll hand over a /27 ephemeral IP block and the NAT details to marta in DM. Also adding a note: adapter will log minimal PII, but we'll redact any full SSNs — config flag available.

sam (sales-eng): Legal/security Q: will we sign their DPA + addendum for HSM? We should loop legal early.

marta (sales): Already looped Legal — they're reviewing the questionnaire answers and will draft the DPA addendum.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: redwood-adapter -> canary-2026-03-25T09:00Z (5% traffic). CI tests: unit + e2e harness.

cal (solutions): Action items (owners): 1) tokenizer run on 200 prompts -> cal (EOD) 2) IP range for staging -> jun (tomorrow 08:30) 3) security questionnaire answers -> vikram + legal (tomorrow noon) 4) pricing examples -> sam (tomorrow COB) 5) eval harness & parity score -> cal + jun (initial by day 2 of POC) 6) canary config + failback -> marie (pre-canary checklist).

marta (sales): Thanks — let's sync 09:00 tomorrow for quick stand (10m). If anything blocks, ping here or DM. :thumbsup:
